sql:
SELECT 
    c.c_nationkey AS nation_key,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value,
    COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count
FROM 
    tpch.customer c
JOIN 
    tpch.orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
GROUP BY 
    c.c_nationkey
ORDER BY 
    nation_key;
